technique_name: Imagine you are talking to a customer who is looking for advice on choosing a phone system. Write a reply that provides relevant information and outlines the benefits of a cloud system.
description: When choosing a phone system for your business, the cloud is an excellent choice. Cloud phone systems are more flexible and cost-effective than traditional hardware-based phone systems. They can scale quickly and easily to accommodate your growing business needs and they typically have fewer maintenance costs.
